probes.question: What do savvy bidders do to avoid the winner's curse?
options: Bid below their estimate of the value
Bid above their estimate of the value
Bid only in the last seconds

probes.question: True or false: the more bidders there are, the more severe the winner's curse gets.

image.alt: A large offshore oil platform standing in calm blue sea, flanked by two small tugboats.

body.question: Several companies bid on an oil field that is worth about the same to each of them, but none knows its exact value. Who tends to overpay?
body.reveal: The winner is the bidder with the most optimistic evaluation, so the winner will tend to overestimate and overpay. This is the winner's curse. Savvy bidders avoid it by bid shading: placing a bid below their estimate of the value.
